counting_rules: O2 and O3 require separately frozen controlled cases; baseline unknown credit does not count as an O2 controlled variant.
A completed conversation requires a successful final response, source binding, and preserved input/output. Model content failures remain evidence and are reported separately from collection failure.
Historical dialogue without a source digest is observed evidence, not a fully traceable completed quota.
Variants share their parent scene family and development split; they never count as new independent scenes.
